name: Cheesy Beef-Stuffed Jalapeño Peppers with Avocado & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 jalapeño peppers
¾ small bunch cilantro
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Divide between the baking sheets and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the cilantro along with beef, cheese, sesame seeds, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 shallots
⅓ kg lean ground beef
1 cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend
3 tbsp sesame seeds
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Stuff jalapeño halves with the beef mixture, pressing firmly into each pepper. Arrange stuffed peppers on the baking sheets, about 1-inch apart.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until jalapeños are tender and beef is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice each half lengthwise into 10 thin wedges. Cut limes into wedges.
Divide stuffed jalapeños between plates; top each with a slice of avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
